title: Ch11 Opening: Stock Buybacks

questions.text: Berkshire spent $9.6 billion on buybacks in Q3 2026. Using Part 2, what happened to its cash, its SHE, its net income and its shares outstanding?

Amazon pays employees partly in stock. What does that do to EPS, and how can a buyback offset it?

Net income is $240K and 60K shares are outstanding all year. What is EPS?
Same company, but it buys back 20K shares on the first day of the year. Net income is still $240K. What is EPS now?
A company buys back $50K of its own shares. What happens to cash?
Same buyback. What happens to SHE?
Same buyback. What happens to net income?
